name: Good Standing: Life Inside Axiom
description: One of the longest-running corponation lifestyle programs in GLMZ, Good Standing presents cheerful documentary-style vignettes of Axiom Consolidated employees living productive, fulfilled lives within the corponation's residential compounds. Every episode emphasizes community, security, and the absence of external uncertainty. The show's production design is immaculate — warm lighting, clean corridors, abundant food — in deliberate contrast to unlicensed depictions of life outside corponation walls.
cultural_impact: Good Standing's aesthetic — the 'Axiom warmth palette' of amber, ivory, and soft green — has been so thoroughly absorbed into corporate marketing culture that it is now parodied in underground art as shorthand for institutional deception.
story_hooks: A character recognizes a 'featured employee' in a recent episode as someone who disappeared from their Shelf neighborhood three years ago
The party is hired to retrieve a former Good Standing production coordinator who has gone independent and is threatening to publish the unedited footage
An Axiom compound resident approaches the party after seeing themselves depicted in a Good Standing episode they don't remember filming
